{"id":"R-001","class":"rigor","priority":"P0","v1_lines":"9062--9133","part_ch":"VII.forcing","finding":"CH-independence treatment does not prove \\(\\mathsf{Con}(\\mathrm{ZFC})\\Rightarrow\\mathsf{Con}(\\mathrm{ZFC}+\\neg\\mathrm{CH})\\): the sketch uses the countable-transitive-model presentation that the adjacent Warning (9107) says does not suffice, and the nonderivability step invokes soundness over two structures never produced, so the theorem statement (9066) overclaims.","required_fix":"Rewrite per the book's own Warning: either present relative consistency with honest cited status or give the correct syntactic route (forcing over finite fragments / ctm with the inaccessibility caveat), deleting the two-structures soundness justification.","acceptance":"Revised passage claims only what its displayed argument or citation actually establishes, and the nonderivability justification is syntactic with no appeal to unexhibited structures.","effort":"L","disposition":"FIX-SOURCE","phase":"2","status":"fixed (4201fbf)"}

{"id":"R-002","class":"rigor","priority":"P0","v1_lines":"7011--7031 vs 6567--6585, 7440--7454","part_ch":"V--VI.coding","finding":"Coding inconsistency: the text asserts iterated Cantor pairing is not the coding used for bounded verification while the fixed machine numbering is built from exactly that pairing, so \\(\\mathsf{Comp}(e,x,s)\\) lacks the bounded extraction from \\(e\\) it needs (the beta-function is applied only to histories), and the gap propagates to the \\(\\Sigma^0_1\\) status of \\(\\mathsf{Prov}_T\\).","required_fix":"Adopt a single coding with a proved bounded-extraction lemma covering machine codes as well as histories, and re-derive the \\(\\Sigma^0_1\\) form of \\(\\mathsf{Comp}\\) and \\(\\mathsf{Prov}_T\\) from it.","acceptance":"One coding is used consistently, the bounded-extraction lemma is a labeled proved result, and the \\(\\Sigma^0_1\\) claims for \\(\\mathsf{Comp}\\) and \\(\\mathsf{Prov}_T\\) cite it with no contradictory prose remaining.","effort":"L","disposition":"FIX-SOURCE","phase":"2","status":"fixed (563da95)"}
